mechanism: NSAIDs like meloxicam can reduce renal blood flow and increase serum creatinine, potentially impairing oxacillin elimination and increasing beta-lactam accumulation; NSAIDs may also increase risk of acute kidney injury when combined with renally-cleared antibiotics.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesic if prolonged therapy needed; adjust oxacillin dosing if renal impairment develops.
